subject: every @comp.*, @meta.*, and @compiler.* directive form at a CODE position in tracked .id source
why: Current metaprogramming law admits no compiler-directive syntax: metaprogramming operates on graph identities, facts, dependencies, demand, worlds, provenance and transformations. Compatibility parsing still maps dotted @comp.* forms onto string-dispatched internal handlers. This ledger inventories that second control plane, and gate/directive.sh prevents a removed form or use from returning.
counting: CODE POSITIONS ONLY. `#` comments are stripped before matching, because prose describing a directive is not a use of it. Forms may not end in a dot; an earlier census produced phantom forms like `@comp.define...` by capturing sentence punctuation.
